name: Floor & Decor PRO Premier Credit Card

localized_names.en: Floor & Decor PRO Premier Credit Card

apr.notes: New accounts as of 02/01/25: purchase APR 26.99%; minimum interest charge $2.

signup_bonus.description: Targeted 2026 offer: eligible participants presented with the offer by Synchrony receive a 5% statement credit on qualifying purchases made between 1/1/2026 and 12/31/2026 that post by 1/7/2027; not combinable with special financing.

notes: Business credit card for Floor & Decor PRO customers. Synchrony lists Floor & Decor among its commercial credit cards. Promotional financing: no interest if paid in full in 180 days on purchases of $299 or more. Floor & Decor's separate Commercial Business Account (30-day terms) is a different product and is not covered here. It is a closed-loop private-label card that does not run on a payment network, so network is other and network_tier is none.
